title: Linear Decomposition Contract
objective: Implement ordinary Python reference contracts for LU, exact QR, and Gram-Schmidt including shape and singular-case semantics
references: SageMath 10.9 matrix2.pyx Matrix.LU, Matrix.QR, Matrix._gram_schmidt_noscale, and Matrix.gram_schmidt
Live SageMath 10.9.post1 oracle probes for tuple entries, reconstruction identities, rectangular ranks, singular inputs, and zero-dimensional shapes

handoff.summary: Added an immutable explicit-shape RationalMatrixData reference value and ordinary CPython implementations of Sage-oriented partial/nonzero-pivot LU, full/reduced exact QR, and exact row Gram-Schmidt. The contracts fix A=P*L*U, A=Q*R, and A=M*G tuple order; rectangular, rank-deficient, singular, dependent-row, and zero-dimensional shapes; rational square-root failure; and deterministic 40x40 baselines. Live SageMath 10.9.post1 probes supply exact LU/QR/Gram fixtures and shape oracles. Nothing is wired into public Matrix yet.
risks: The reference scalar domain is Fraction, so QR and orthonormal Gram-Schmidt intentionally raise when a required square root leaves QQ. A future QQbar or exact-ring adapter must also provide conjugation semantics before extending this contract to complex exact fields.

The helper currently fixes Sage's default PLU tuple contract for explicit partial/nonzero pivoting. Public Matrix.LU still needs an adapter for pivot=None auto-selection and the optional compact return format.

A full native aggregate reached all FFI, sanitizer lifecycle, compiler, matrix migration, and finite-field budget gates, then transiently measured inherited ZZ density_500 at 9.88ms normalized against an 8ms budget. Immediate isolated runs passed at 2.13ms before rebase and 3.17ms after rebase. The first aggregate attempt also exposed and then repaired a missing worktree-local M4RI prefix; a redundant third aggregate was stopped at coordinator request.
next_steps: In the integration lane, add src/lib/sagejs/linear_algebra/decompositions.py to pyrightconfig.json and test/linear-decomposition-contract.cjs to test/node-test-manifest.cjs. The existing linear-algebra-algorithms prefix already owns the source, so no package-graph entry is needed.

Wire Matrix.LU, Matrix.QR, and Matrix.gram_schmidt through a lazy sagejs.linear_algebra.decompositions import. For ZZ and QQ, bulk-export once into RationalMatrixData and construct each returned Matrix over QQ with the recorded explicit dimensions; preserve Sage's pivot=None, compact-format, mutability/cache, and exception behavior in the public adapter.

After public differential tests are stable, benchmark each method and replace only measured hot paths with generated FLINT resources or source-transparent typed Python while retaining these ordinary-Python contracts as the oracle.
